note: Net profit and withholding returns appear in older Lexington-Fayette forms (April 15 for calendar-year filers); current-year pages were not confirmed.

items.title: File Louisville Metro occupational license tax net profits return (OL-3)
items.description: Entities with business nexus in Louisville/Jefferson County pay the occupational license tax (2.2% resident rate) on net profits; due the 15th day of the 4th month after fiscal year end.

items.title: Register for and withhold Louisville occupational license tax (W-1)
items.description: Employers register with the Revenue Commission and withhold occupational license tax from employee compensation.
